free_tier.stated: MEGA offers 20 GB of free encrypted cloud storage.

per_object_cap.stated: With MEGA’s unlimited file size, no file is ever too big.

egress.terms: For non-MEGA users, or those with a free account, the amount of data that can be downloaded from your IP address in six hours is limited.

tooling: Native rclone backend 'mega' (Tier 2, v1.41+); official MEGAcmd CLI; MEGA S4 (S3-compatible) is the paid object store.
chaining: 20 GB + N x 5 GB achievements per account, x unlimited free accounts. Achievement bonuses are per-account and do NOT compound within one account beyond one of each, so the multiplication is accounts, not achievements.

limits.value: The limit is based on the amount of data downloaded from your IP address over the past six hours.
Complete one of the following actions to earn more free storage.

limits_note: Transfer quota is calculated per IP address over 6-hour windows on free accounts. Bonus storage achievements expire after 365 days. Client-side encryption is enforced across uploads.
reliability_note: Does not lose data; throttles hard per IP and per link. Accounts with no login for ~3 months are at risk of quota cuts.
